expectedOutcome: After completing the roadmap, learners can recognize common problem types by their prerequisite knowledge and maintain a complete review system spanning linear structures, trees, graphs, search, greedy algorithms, and dynamic programming.
goal: Complete a systematic training cycle that covers the core data structures and algorithms in a clear dependency order.
notRecommendedFor: There's only one or two weeks left for the interview.
The same code has been completely brushed and the same path is recorded.

phases.focus: Build a foundation in linear structures through array storage, binary-search boundaries, two pointers, and sliding windows.
phases.title: Array Foundations and Boundaries

phases.focus: Practice linked-list insertion, deletion, reversal, intersection, and cycle detection.
phases.title: Linked-List Pointer Operations

phases.focus: Master set membership, frequency maps, and grouping strategies with hash tables.
phases.title: Hash Tables and Grouping

phases.focus: Practice in-place string operations, KMP, and two-pointer techniques across arrays and linked lists.
phases.title: Strings and Two Pointers

phases.focus: Build foundations in stack/queue transformations, expression processing, monotonic structures, and Top K problems.
phases.title: Stacks, Queues, and Priority Queues

phases.focus: Systematically practice tree traversal, paths, construction, lowest common ancestors, and binary search tree properties.
phases.title: Binary Trees and Binary Search Trees

phases.focus: Use combinations, partitions, subsets, permutations, and board problems to practice decision trees and pruning.
phases.title: Backtracking Search

phases.focus: Learn how local choices lead to global optima through sequence, interval, jump, and allocation problems.
phases.title: Greedy Strategies

phases.focus: Progress from basic states to knapsack, house robber, stock, subsequence, and edit-distance problems.
phases.title: Dynamic Programming Core

phases.focus: Use monotonic stacks to solve next-greater-element, temperature, rainwater, and histogram-area problems.
phases.title: Monotonic Stack Consolidation

phases.focus: Cover graph traversal, islands, topological sorting, union-find, shortest paths, and minimum spanning trees.
phases.title: Complete Graph Roadmap

prerequisites: Basic grammar of a dominant programming language
A steady investment of more than 6 hours per week
